notes.title: Celebrate World Happiness Day with OhShape
notes.notes:
Today is World Happiness Day, and what better way to celebrate than by moving, grooving, and having a blast in VR? At OhShape, we believe that happiness is about feeling good, staying active, and enjoying the rhythm of life—literally!

For those new to this VR classic game, OhShape is the ultimate full-body VR rhythm game that gets you dancing, dodging, and punching to the beat. Inspired by the Japanese TV show *Hole in the Wall*, this immersive experience is perfect for players of all skill levels, whether you're stepping into VR for the first time or you're a rhythm game pro looking for a new challenge.


OhShape is available across all major VR platforms, like [url=https://store-global.picoxr.com/global/detail/1/1233]Pico,[/url] Sony’s [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5992-PPSA17972_00-0418343728707397]PSVR2[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/1098100/OhShape]Steam [/url] (currently with a 60% discount!) and [url=https://www.meta.com/experiences/ohshape/2522558964527688/]Meta Quest[/url].


Don’t wait—celebrate happiness, movement, and music today! Grab OhShape on your favourite platform now and make this World Happiness Day one to remember! 🎶💃

notes.title: From Dream to Reality: Five Years of OhShape and Odders
notes.notes:
When  we look back 5 years, we can see a small group of developers passionate about technology and the future. We had experience in software and hardware development and we were early adopters of VR devices, but creating videogames for a platform such as Oculus Quest was something totally new.

[b]Today, or first step into the amazing world of immersive technologies turns five years.[/b]

[b]A thrilling journey[/b]

We strongly believe in the infinite possibilities of the XR world and we found a great idea that could be our first step into the VR realm: a rhythm game where you have to use your whole body, but simple enough to understand the mechanics with the snap of a finger. It also had to be fun to enjoy with family and friends. After a brainstorming of ideas, we decided to create OhShape, a VR rhythm game inspired by the Japanese TV show Brain Wall and videogame cult classics like the popular arcade Dance Dance Revolution.

Walls with different poses come at you and you have to fit in, dodge or punch your way trough the level. Wether you make it look stylish or fun, it’s up to you!

[b]What OhShape mean to us[/b]

OhShape is our first project, and because of this it will always hold a special place in our hearts. What we learnt and grew during its development is an unforgettable experience, and not only from the point of view of the knowledge and experience we acquire in the field of videogame development: it also forged the foundations of Odders as a company.

The first year working with OhShape was a crazy rollercoaster: we received precious feedback at video game fairs, we faced the thrill of launching OhShape on Steam and Oculus Quest, we were locked in 2020 due to the pandemic and we went to work hard to improve the OhShape experience with everything we had.

During this process, our players became a fundamental pillar to continue improving day by day. We found a super friendly and supportive community that gave us great help and feedback. We also noticed how much OhShape was helping people to stay fit during the lockdown, which inspired us to put more efforts into this type of developments.

[b]A year of renewal[/b]

Being 5 years old is a lifetime in videogame development, specially considering how fast XR technology is evolving with new headsets almost every year. But we don’t want to forget about our legacy, that’s why we decided to add content and improvements to OhShape in 2024. We started the year with the Power Up update, adding a new fitness album and making the DLC Electro Party free for every OhShape owner. On top of that, we recently added LIV support to the Steam version, making it easy for the content creators who gave us support through these years… and for the newcomers who are discovering our game today!


[b]Looking at the future[/b]

We do not have enough words to describe the excitement of this anniversary. From Odders we want to thank you for your support throughout these years. We have exciting new projects in the pipeline, but we won’t forget about OhShape and we will always listen to our community to keep adding details into our beloved first project.

If you want to be part of our friendly community, make new friends and discover our other projects, please don’t forget to say hi in our Discord! https://discord.gg/OddersGames

notes.title: OhShape v.1.9.68 - Flow Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

At OhShape we have keep working on improving the feeling of the game, and here are some Quality of Life improvements requested by our community in the past months:

-Better feeling when you pass through the walls: some people had the feeling they could hit their head with the top of the silhouettes even when the calibration was set on point. To reduce this sensation, we have added a fading effect that feels way better when you play.

-Auto-recentering tweak: some time ago, we made adjustments to improve the synchronisation between the sounds of objects and music. This system worked as intented, slightly pushing the center of the game as you move around. However, there was a problem for people playing in small spaces: they could end up outside the boundaries of the guardian area without realising it. We have changed this: now the floor is fixated to the same position but the objects still follow the player, allowing the sync benefits of that system without the risk of getting carried away and leaving the guardian area.

-More natural hand position: instead of showing the hands with outstretched fingers, the hands now have a half-closed position more reminiscent of hands holding controllers.

-More satisfying coin FXs: now when you grab a golden coin, it explodes with a flash and a particle trail. The previous system could be confusing for newcomers because they didn't know whether they were doing it right or not.
This is all for today, keep an eye on future updates since we are going to add a new feature soon! :)

Shipwrecked on the small island of Harlath, players will adventure through a semi-open-world environment and multiple dungeons, battling foes, solving puzzles, and ultimately discovering the nature of the curse that looms over the island.
 
Stones of Harlath is a first person RPG in VR. Players will play as a powerful battle mage, wield swords, shields and maces and cast powerful magic by drawing runes with their controller.

Stones of Harlath is inspired by gaming classics such as Ultima Underworld, Arx Fatalis and Heretic/Hexen, but enhanced by modern lighting and the immersive nature of VR. The game visual features include pixel-art textures, low poly models and high-quality lighting in a mix of 3D environments and 2D sprites.

Join this unlikely duo through challenging throwbacks to all your favorite classics from the late 16-bit and early 32-bit era of games inside a virtual reality world.

OhShape (Odders Lab) and Synth Riders (Kluge Interactive) have teamed up again on the anniversary of their first collaboration to bring a DLC with the electronic sounds of Caravan Palace.


[b]<|º  º|>  The Caravan Palace Music Pack <|º  º|> [/b] features 5 songs from a fine selection of this electronic group from France. Heavily influenced by the Gypsy scene, Django Reinhardt and the sophisticated orchestrations of 1940s jazz, Caravan Palace fuses this with elements of future bass, trap, deep house and African house. Here are the full track list:

* Wonderland
* Lone Digger
* Tattoos
* Rock It For Me

notes.title: OhShape V 1.0 Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[b]OhShape 2020 Updates Chronology[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229684/b3d38fe5c7c514c2a8e6ca1f72eed1a1cc6081ec.jpg[/img]

2020... What a ride! We remember the release of OhShape on Quest with great joy and pride, it truly was a magical moment for us! However it was a bit bittersweet because just a few weeks after the release, we found ourselves immersed in the global pandemic, which led us to major changes.

But this didn't daunt us, on the contrary, it made us work harder. In April we released our #StayHome challenge to help our players withstand confinement. It was a long map with upbeat music, punches and squats to make you sweat and keep you in good shape!

In June we joined forces with Synth Riders to create something never seen before in the VR rhythm realm, and thus was born our first Delight Collab: one free update for OhShape and Synth Riders with maps made for the song Delight by Jamie Berry. We were very happy to bring our communities closer together, so we repeated this move and later in September we released another collab featuring the song Carry On by F.O.O.L.

OhShape expanded onto new platforms such as Pico VR and PlayStation VR. We have always been listening to our community’s feedback and we added a bunch of free updates with new features, songs and new environments like our Ice Planet or Tower Reloaded, a reconstruction of our first stage.
We had a special surprise in store for the end of the year: our first DLC, Electro Party! 6 energetic songs in an awesome new dark environment now available in all platforms!

[b]So... What's next?[/b]
We started 2021 with our OhShape Monthly Challenges, a way to engage with our community and introduce you to other awesome games by other developers! This year has just started and we are preparing some other interesting updates. More DLCs? New collabs? New environments? Follow us on social media and be the first to know more!

notes.title: OhShape in the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
It has been almost one year since we left Early Access... And we can't believe how much OhShape has grown since that moment! Throughout this year we have enjoyed the company of a great community that has grown greatly and we have started many adventures.

We released the #StayHome challenge and we realised about the great potential of OhShape as a fitness game. We made 2 collaborations with Synth Riders (the [i]Delight[/i] and [i]Carry On[/i] songs), an unprecedented event within the VR games that brought our communities closer. We created a event system for special dates of the year, like the temporary Halloween mode.

On top of that, OhShape has been growing with new environments, songs and features extracted from the feedback of our players. Now we ask you to [b]nominate OhShape for VR Game of the Year[/b] in the Steam Awards 2020.

If you enjoyed OhShape, give us a hand and let everyone know how cool our game is so we can keep improving and pushing it even further!

notes.title: OhShape Halloween Event
notes.notes:

Run to your home, block out doors and windows, light some candles and plug in your VR headset. You may think OhShape isn't the perfect game for this time of the year, but you couldn't be more wrong.
